answer: First, pay the witch tax: a new identity pays a 90-unit genesis tax, never refunded, and waits 4 epochs under observation. Then, earn it back: each honest epoch returns 15% as fee credit; a clean identity recovers all 90. Finally, cheating burns the rest: a caught forgery loses the remainder and freezes 8 epochs. The kernel is the sunk cost: the tax cannot be reused, so 1,000 fakes pay 90,000 units up front, and at a 30% catch rate 27,000 burn. The hollow promise collapses: honest agents earn it back. The atlas of costs: 90 units each, paid once, never recycled.
